reviews.title: No subscription receipts available
reviews.text: Soothe app and website don’t provide subscription receipts

reviews.title: Unsafe
reviews.text: I chose a handful of therapists to book with, but the app chose a random therapist for me instead. One who didn’t have a photo, no reviews, and who just joined Soothe a few months ago. I cancelled the appointment right away and was charged $77. My points weren’t refunded either. Horrible experience.

reviews.title: No show
reviews.text: I was in LA for a red carpet event and booked a makeup appointment with “Jennifer”  (5 star reviews). I contacted her the day before so she knew where to park and to let her know what I wanted. She said she would need 1 1/2 hours. Jennifer did not show up for my appointment  the next day. I went to leave a 1 star review but was told I couldn’t because the appointment never happened! No wonder she sits at 5 stars if you can’t report her no shows! Soothe said she called in sick. I was never informed.

reviews.title: It’s a scam
reviews.text: Do not sign up for the subscription!  You can never book, every appointment is cancelled at the last second and you just accumulate points you can’t use, Soothe won’t refund and you lose when you cancel. Total scam.

reviews.title: Bad app and customer service experience
reviews.text: Today i tried for 35 minutes on the website and app while both crashed over and over.   Just go on Google Maps and find a good place and drive there. YOUll get your massage faster with less headache.

reviews.title: Thank you. Bill
reviews.text: Not good with computers but I did I. Hopefully it works

reviews.title: Scam. Refusing to refund after making impossible to book for months
reviews.text: Scam. This place used to work for me, but there’s been a technical issue that's prevented me from booking anything for months, and customer service refuses to refund my membership because of their T&Cs. I've emailed support for months about this, and they keep saying they'll escalate to leadership, then the same person replies with "no because our T&Cs." Meanwhile, I've been charged hundreds and the system continues to show zero availability in my area for the foreseeable months. Cancel while you can.

reviews.title: Garbage customer service
reviews.text: The app mis-represents how easy is it to book providers, then their customer service ghosts you when you get locked out on every first login attempt.

reviews.title: Tech support; unreliable, massage therapists
reviews.text:
Contacting support has been a very difficult experience and very stressful. They respond, but give advice that is were either incorrect or unrelated to what you asked for.

Also, the massage therapists are constantly canceling on you with very little notice, making it extremely difficult to book a reliable massage.

reviews.title: Glitchy and not intuitive
reviews.text: The app is fine, but the glitches make for a very sour experience. First, a particular therapist may appear to have wide open availability. In reality, they have much more limited spots open and you have to wait minutes or hours to see if your appointment will actually be accepted. Then after your session is complete, often the next day, you get a prompt to leave a review and a tip. Problem is that you’ve already submitted a review and provided a tip. So you have to send yourself a receipt and ensure the tip was actually given. It’s just very confusing and unnecessary.

reviews.title: Horrible Scammers Do Not Book
reviews.text: I was recommended this ap from a friend and it had been a entire horrible experience! I booked for 4 days straight and each one was canceled and not met for the booking, they don’t have any providers to do the work but will collect your money and won’t refund you. I been trying to get refunded and they insist on keeping my money and not being able to complete the reservation. Stay far away from this ap unless you want to be scammed out of your money find a real massage office that you can walk in and pay don’t trust this ap

reviews.title: DO NOT USE THIS SERVICE
reviews.text: I tried to book an appointment for my husband for Valentine’s Day and for some reason, although booking the appointment at a specific time, they gave me the appointment at the wrong time, but since I had booked it within the four hour timeframe from the appt, they would charge me 100% of the reschedule and 100% of the cancellation eve though this wasn’t even my fault. Their system sucks the chat box sucks. It’s hard to get ahold of anybody directly. They’ll communicate with you by email and they’re the only ones that will call you but if you call them you won’t get through to them. The masseuses don’t even have a way to release the appointment and pass it on to someone else. If that masseuse can’t work with you then you’re pretty much stuck. I am extremely disappointed and I do not recommend using this application and the service provider.

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text:
With the subscription- if you decide to stop paying and have unused credits those credits expire which in my case would have been a waste of over $2k so now I’m stuck paying to not lose these credits. 

Also the providers are unreliable- just had one cancel 40 minutes before the service. If you cancel last minute on them, you pay. If they cancel? You get nothing.

reviews.title: Scam avoid at all costs
reviews.text: It’s a scam guys. You pay your monthly membership and providers don’t arrive, support is poor, avoid at all costs. You’ll do better with many other services. Not what it used to be ….trust me I’ve spent over 20k with this app …back when it was decent.

reviews.title: Therapist cancels last minute
reviews.text: Therapist cancelled last minute after I arranged my whole day around the massage. They call me and tell me “sorry and I’ll get a refund and that’s all they can do”. Ridiculous service. Clearly you need to reimburse me for wasting my time.

reviews.title: Please read
reviews.text: I put in my preferences that I prefer female masseuse and you’re sending a mail that’s wrong

reviews.title: A service scheduling app that doesn’t…
reviews.text:
Send email confirmation 
Set calendar event
Send *any* push notifications

They happily take your money and hope you forget. 

Fail.

reviews.title: Bad management and extremely unprofessional providers- no shows and last minute cancellation
Wonderful non-spa, cozy alternative!
reviews.text:
If case you can’t make it to a spa or simply want a massage, facial, nail, or hair services done in-home, in-hotel, or any other location than a spa, this is the place to order these services from! : -)

Some states have limited services, based on availability of service type people, but massages are always available in every state I’ve tried so far (CA, MA, DC, VA, NC, NY, FL).

All employees have a background check and are safe to have in your home (thinking of women in particular). I have never felt uncomfortable or unsafe. 

What a great, cozy alternative to a spa! Love this app service! You should enjoy it too!

reviews.title: So Awesome
reviews.text: You know the experience is great when you fall asleep! I get the Swedish massage and almost every time I fall asleep on the table. The music, the techniques…yup knocked out !

reviews.title: No refund
reviews.text: I booked a massage for August 5, but no provider was assigned. I rescheduled for August 6, and the same thing happened again. I had to change my booking to a Swedish massage instead of my original choice. I emailed the company requesting a refund due to the repeated inconvenience, but no one replied to my email, and I never received my money back. Very disappointing experience, and I hope the company improves its scheduling and customer service.

reviews.title: Spam Push Notifications STILL?
reviews.text:
I just downloaded this app again after previously deleting it when I wasn’t able to book through it and all I was getting with Spam… Downloaded it again got a massage. Great now I’m getting spam push notifications again, and don’t see any option to customize the notifications I receive. So I can either turn off all notifications and never know when my massage therapist is showing up or needs help, or get spammed with useless Father’s Day deals… 

I thought Apple required app developers to give us an option to opt out of the marketing messages… but it’s been at least a year since I tried to sign up for this last time so I think that would’ve been implemented by now… I might have to just delete this app again.. waste of time. 

PREVIOUS- i tried to give it a shot, even though I had to turn off all app notifications to avoid them spamming me (it’s only on or off, no opt out of marketing… nice..), and the “book now” button did nothing. No error message, no fields highlighted, just nothing. Quit the app and tried again and nothing… so I guess this app is not for me! Lol good luck!

reviews.title: No Shows, No Customer Support, Money Gone
reviews.text:
Purchased a gift card for my mother, booked through the app twice and both times a therapist failed to arrive at all with zero communication.  Have made multiple attempts to contact Support via chat and email (no phone number exists we’ve found) and they fail to respond.  So the money for the gift card is gone with no idea how to get it back.
Update: The Developer Response pointed me back to the non-responsive email address.  Money still gone.

reviews.title: Instant book is terrible
reviews.text: I used to be able to request different therapists in the area. Now I can only do “instant book” I only see two therapists on instant book when I used to see over 80+ in my area. Huge disappointment and the service reps via chat were not helpful. They just talk in circles.

reviews.title: Change It Back
reviews.text: Really enjoyed this app up until you could no longer see the therapists available in your area. Please change it back to where you can see who the providers are! Until then I refuse to use this anymore.

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: Last two massages were cancelled 10 minutes before they were supposed to start. Difficult to get a refund in a timely manner. Will not be using this app moving forward as their providers are unreliable and the company doesn’t care if they cancel over and over again. Ridiculous.

reviews.title: Another NO SH9W
reviews.text: A few weeks ago I scheduled a couples massage and 1 therapist didn’t show. The therapist that arrived wasn’t good at all and asked plenty of questions about preferences and ignored the answers. I called and complained and was offered a $20 coupon as an apology. I said, no thank you and was contacted by customer service who gave me $165 credit and blocked the therapist from seeing us again. I booked a massage today, using the application but 30 minutes after my appointment I called the therapist who said the appointment never showed up. She is on her way now but said she would arrive at 1:30 - an hour after the appointment. The massages used to be $99 and the quality of the experience was so much better. Once is a misnomer but 3 bad experiences is a strike out.

reviews.title: A great travel experience!
reviews.text: I recently booked my first Soothe massage while traveling and it was honestly SO nice to not have to scramble to find a spa in the middle of my itinerary in an unfamiliar city. My provider was prompt, professional, and so attentive and responsive to my requests. The convenience and service really just couldn’t be beat.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This is a scam. Please do not use this app.

reviews.title: Spectacular Service
reviews.text: I recently booked Soothe for our girl’s trip and had a wonderful experience with the massage therapist. She was very attentive and professional. The ladies in the group felt so comfortable and relaxed after their chair massage. I will highly recommend them to all of my friends and family!

reviews.title: Awful Service
reviews.text: They bill you monthly and it’s non refundable, and you have to be a member to request appointments, yet when you try to make an appointment, their providers cancel on you last minute.  Makes it very hard to use “points” that you have to pay for monthly.

reviews.title: Horrible Service
reviews.text: I have tried to call soothe 10x plus sent 5 plus emails to no response.  They suspended my account with over 14,000 points and refuse to answer my calls or emails and provide any services that I have already paid for.  I have never encountered a company with worst customer service.  Before spending money with them, I would highly suggest you do your research and go elsewhere.  I have over $1500 spent and cannot redeem any of it because they refuse to answer phone calls, emails or chats or call me back.  I even disputed my last charge and they recharged me.  I have never had headaches like this.  I would stay far away from this company.

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text:
I signed up for the membership and what’ a waste of money. I could never get the day or time I requested. 

Had two therapists  cancel at the last minute due to “an emergency“

Canceled my membership and then was informed that I could no longer use the massage I had already prepaid for because I was no longer member? Now try and make sense of that.

Just don’t do it

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: I used Soothe when it came out. Great! The ability to get a massage at home on my term was amazing. Then eventually it became almost impossible to get anybody…on my term. So I uninstalled the app. I tried it again a few days ago. Same problem. I requested probably 10 different providers but none  available or offering me different days. If I wanted a massage in 3 days I would go to a massage place and get a massage. The whole point of on-demand is that it’s on my terms otherwise there’s no point. On top of that it’s NOT cheap so I would expect a little better. They have now all the services like hair, nails….over priced of course but it’s all fine. I’m ok spending double or triple the regular price to get the service in the comfort of my home on my terms…but unfortunately that’s not what Soothe provides. Also when someone requests an appointment and get nobody I would imagine support would reach out to help…nope! So convenience of the service 0, customer service 0, cost 0…the app works very well though so good point for the developers. I imagine Soothe will not be around much longer….

reviews.text: My experience with the professional massage therapist was great but I was charged three times for the tip and when I went to the support chat for help they had terrible customer service skills. Their sentences do not make sense and they type in text slang…

reviews.title: App needs to be fixed
reviews.text: It is having me reset my password. I don’t know my password, hot forgot password, get a reset link and it takes me back to the app to reset password, enter old password (that I don’t know) and enter new password.

reviews.title: Can’t reset password
reviews.text: Wish I could use this app but I forgot my password and if you click reset, you get an email that just opens the app to the login page. So useless, so not relaxing.

reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: The app idea is awesome but the masseuses ive been getting are NOT worth the $199 + $40 tip. It’s very hit or miss. Ive tried 10 now and had 2 decent ones.

reviews.title: Password reset is the worst
reviews.text: I have been trying to reset my password for 30 minutes. All it does is take you to the app to make you reset the password with a link then you click that link and it takes you back to the password area, makes no sense whatsoever
